name: Hadal-Hollow
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by an ancient meteor crater and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
